summary: Toppoint Holdings filed an 8-K reporting results of its September 8, 2026 Annual Meeting. Holders of 15,712,711 of 24,700,000 shares (63.61%) constituted a quorum. Stockholders approved, by wide margins, authorization for one or more reverse splits up to an aggregate 1-for-900 effective by August 24, 2029, a Nevada-to-Delaware reincorporation conversion, an authorized-share increase from 300 million to 1 billion, and election of five directors; director Jimmy M. Wong did not stand for re-election after his term expired. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, or premium is involved; watch for future reverse-split ratio selection, Delaware governance changes, and any resulting exchange listing compliance effects.
